title: Pro-rated starter credit decay and SQ-driven conversion hooks
creator: Ava Moreno
description: Run an experiment to test a pro-rated starter credit model combined with an automated Security Questionnaire (SQ) touchpoint for enterprise-seeming signups. Hypothesis: making credits pro-rate based on early activity and surfacing an SQ-driven upgrade path for accounts that trigger specific enterprise signals will increase trial-to-paid conversion and reduce wasted free credits. Goals are to improve conversion velocity (time-to-first-charge), increase % of trials that convert within 30 days, and reduce expired-unused-credit churn. This ticket covers PRD-level decisions, instrumentation requirements, and rollout coordination with Eng and Design.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment matrix implemented: control, pro-rated decay, extended-expiry, SQ-touch variant
Instrumentation events for credit grant/redeem/expiry, SQ email sent, SQ completed, upgrade CTA click, and charge initiated are logged to analytics
Dashboard widgets for primary metrics (conversion rate at 7/14/30d, time-to-first-charge, unused credit ratio) available in Looker/Grafana
Design assets for in-app CTAs and SQ modal reviewed and merged
Security questionnaire automation flow reviewed by Security and has a clear opt-out path for customers
experiment_design: Cohorts (randomized at signup): Control (current fixed 1000 credits, 14d expiry), Variant A (pro-rated decay: 1000 credits but decays 10% daily after day 7 if unused), Variant B (extended expiry: 1000 credits, 30d expiry), Variant C (SQ-assisted: current credits + automated SQ email + in-product SQ CTA)
Target population: new signups with >=1 API key issued and company email domain (to enrich enterprise signal); cap at 20k signups for initial run
Duration: run until 6,000 signups per arm or 6 weeks whichever first
Randomization stratification: by signup source (self-serve web, marketplace, partner) to avoid source bias
measurement_plan: Secondary metrics: time-to-first-charge (median days), % of credits redeemed before expiry, proportion of accounts that trigger SQ and complete it, NRR uplift from cohort after 90 days
Telemetry: events as defined in instrumentation doc (see attachments). Use experiment join key for attribution. Confidence threshold: p < 0.05 and minimum absolute uplift > 1.5pp for primary metric
Stopping rules: if Variant A or C causes >5% decrease in MAU or causes >3% increased support tickets related to credit confusion, pause and investigate
rollout_plan: Week 0: finalize instrumentation and feature flags with ENG; design assets freeze; security review signoff
Week 1: internal dogfood across two customer success accounts; smoke test metrics; QA on Dedicated and Private paths
Week 2-6: ramp to full experiment volume per design; daily monitoring of critical alerts; weekly checkpoint with stakeholders
Post-experiment: analyze results, publish PRD update with recommended default, and plan migration path for long-lived changes (billing/backfill decisions)
open_questions: Should pro-rated decay reduce available credits only for generation endpoints or include embeddings/other units? Need ENG cost model input
If Variant C (SQ-assisted) yields higher conversion, what is acceptable SLA for human follow-up from Sales? (affects costs)
How to communicate decay to users without causing confusion or support load? Design to propose messaging tone and in-product education
Is there legal/contract implication for auto-escalation to Sales when an SQ is completed? Legal to advise
